notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Nothing much here. But we're still making the game better! :)
 Fixed the issue that the player can create a box that overlaps a blcok in the level.
 Removed several shortcuts.
 Minor bugs fixes

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
v1.0.2 is live now. Here are the changes:
 Moved the Destruction Mask location in Snowland-1
 Added two more boxes in Snowland-1
 Removed shortcuts in some levels
 Fixed the issue of multiple Creation boxes due to low FPS
 Fixed the issue that the button will not release if the enemy turns into an ice cube when leaves the button.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
v1.0.1
 Fixed Forest-1 tutorial bug
 Fixed water collision in some levels
 Removed shortcuts in some levels
 Minor bugs fixed

Thanks for your support!
We'll bring the best gameplay experience for you.
